correctness.rationale: For all fixed n≥3, order density n!alpha^n product x_i^(-alpha-1) on the no-triangle feasible cone becomes a unit-Jacobian Fibonacci-slack integral. A uniform integrable product majorant for alpha≥2 proves its sharp endpoint prefactor; Scheffé proves conditional joint TV convergence. Independently, Pareto log-gaps are exponential with rates (n-i)alpha. The event is a union of neighboring violations, whose individual probabilities are rate products times ∫log(1+e^-y)dy=pi²/12 plus O_n(alpha³), and pairwise intersections are at most O_n(alpha³). This derives the exact alpha² coefficient and a unique marked violation distribution. Exact rational reconstruction and 4421 checker assertions corroborate finite computations but do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: For a newly studied exact integral in random stick geometry, the behavior of actual conditioned stick configurations and rare triangle marks at both extreme tail indices is a motivated missing object. The all-fixed-n sharp Fibonacci prefactor and independent nontrivial slack rates characterize the concentration geometry, while the universal rare-pair density and explicit rank weighting characterize the heavy-tail breakdown. This is a natural two-endpoint structural classification rather than a textbook substitution, arbitrary small-n numerics or a gain in a known table.
